purpose: Algorithm hypothesis probes; not AC25 acceptance. No engine or Cargo ran during benchmark loops. Synthetic query results do not establish production timing.
fixture: content/dev/maps/stress-env-volumes.prl; same rebuilt fixture as parent acceptance manifest
workload: 10,000 synthetic positions near 40 actual emitter origins: 250 positions per emitter. Grouped order and transposed emitter-interleaved order; independent exact queries in 64-point timed batches. Three repetitions of 100 full 10k-point batches, reported median/p10/p90 and nested mean.
verification_compile: same driver command with postretro-next-query-verify.rs and output suffix -verify; variants baseline and grid

recommendation: Bounded grid + precomputed ranks and validated exact unit-axis entry bounds. Grid interleaved median .2344-.2348ms versus baseline .534-.593ms; grouped .2274-.2279ms. Production integration additionally preserves invalid original padded-bound behavior and uses two-pass CSR construction to bound temporary storage.
limitations: Timing probes do not capture live particle distribution or engine CPU/GPU power coupling.
No frequency/thermal telemetry recorded during standalone probes.
Prototype wide tree lacked depth-capped-leaf support and was rejected on performance.
Prototype exact-axis bounds did not protect malformed original supplied bounds; production implementation does.
No spatial grid quantization of results: candidate selection only, exact brush predicates and independent field reduction remain.

initial_timer_probes.notes: Diagnostic synthetic emitter-near points; not acceptance proof. Any run during concurrent Cargo compilation excluded from conclusions. Later grid research used emitter-interleaved points and actual release dependencies.
